page.notes: Printed "esset" appears as "effet" in the scan; transcribed as printed. Catchword "giùs" is the first word of the next page and is at the lower right, below the last line. The word "longiùs" is split at the line end as "lon-" with the catchword completing it. Some italic and roman distinctions in the scan are small and were checked against the letterforms; the Roman numerals are copied as printed, with "xx" in lower case after "Iunii".
